name: Medical Aids Subsidy Scheme (MASS)
summary: Subsidised aids and equipment for Queenslanders with a permanent condition or disability who hold a Health Care Card or other concession card.
who: Hold an eligible card in your own name, including a Centrelink Health Care Card
Have a permanent or stable condition or disability and meet clinical criteria for each aid
catches: Covers aids such as communication, continence, daily living and mobility aids, home oxygen, medical grade footwear and orthoses.

source.label: Queensland Health: MASS - Can I apply?

evidence.quote: You hold one of the following eligibility cards in your own name:
You are a permanent resident of Queensland.
